mgmt_bio.text: Alex Norstrom serves as co-CEO of Spotify Technology SA alongside Gustav Soderstrom, the pair having stepped up after co-founder Daniel Ek transitioned from CEO to Chairman at the end of 2025. Norstrom brings business and commercial expertise, complementing Soderstrom's product and technology focus, and both have worked closely with Ek for more than a decade. Under this leadership, capital allocation priorities centre on reinvesting in the business for future growth, mostly via internal R&D but also acquisitions, alongside returning excess capital through opportunistic share repurchases.
